name: Koujo Ryouzoku Housou ~Rakuen no Propaganda~
original_name: 皇女凌俗放送～楽園のプロパガンダ～
source:
A military coup occurs at a small island Balalaika. At the same time in Japan TV producer goes missing. This minister shows up as a military minister of the new island regime with the main aim being capture attention of viewers with any means possible. Public humiliation entertainment program is launched with the members of former king family insulted in the public.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
巴拉莱卡小岛发生军事政变。与此同时，日本电视制片人失踪。这位部长以新岛屿政权的军事部长的身份出现，主要目的是想尽一切办法吸引观众的注意力。推出当众侮辱前国王家族成员的当众羞辱娱乐节目。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
